title: A coherent module has a local finite free cokernel presentation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], G an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] coherent in the sense of [pqf-def-coherent], and x a point of X. There exist an open V containing x, integers m,n >= 0 and an O_V-linear map a: O_V^{oplus m} -> O_V^{oplus n} such that Coker(a) is isomorphic to G|_V. The free terms are finite categorical biproducts of the unit module restricted to the slice site over V, as in [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]; ranks zero are allowed.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BW (lemma-coherent-finite-presentation), proof; finite type and presentation Definitions 01B5 and 01BN.

proof.text: Finite type of G supplies a finite free epimorphism b on a neighbourhood W of x. Reindex its finite basis by ULift (Fin n). Coherence makes kernel b finite type on W.

Choose finite generators for this kernel on a smaller neighbourhood V of x. Restriction preserves epimorphisms and kernels because it leaves the stalks on V unchanged. Compose the free epimorphism onto the restricted kernel with its inclusion into the restricted free term to obtain a.

The restricted b is a cokernel of a in the abelian category of module sheaves. Cokernel uniqueness yields Coker(a) isomorphic to G.over V. Identify the two free modules with the biproducts of the restricted unit.

mathlib_searches.query: A coherent module sheaf admits locally a cokernel presentation by two finite free module sheaves
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: presentationOfIsCokernelFree, generatorsOfIsCokernelFree, IsFinitePresentation and associated constructors. These assume a presentation; none deduces it from coherence.
Two hits: Presentation.isColimit and Presentation.map_relations_I. The first supplies a cokernel from existing generators and relations; it does not supply a local finite presentation from coherence.

Mathlib has presentation constructors, not coherent-to-finite-presentation. Local rg found private finitePresentation_of_coherent in TwistedSectionsFiniteDimensional, which assumes IsLocallyNoetherian. Restriction helpers exist, but not this theorem for arbitrary schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_local_finite_presentation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (G : X.Modules)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) (x : X) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens), x ∈ V ∧ ∃ (m n : ℕ)
      (a : (⨁ fun _ : Fin m ↦ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over V) ⟶
        (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over V)),
      Nonempty ((cokernel a) ≅ G.over V)
